en: HEADLINE: the GSC Page indexing build finally refreshed after ten stale readings (4 Sep -> 14 Sep) and indexed pages fell 87 -> 76 while not-indexed rose 119 -> 146.

'Blocked by robots.txt' jumped 6 -> 20 and 'Crawled - currently not indexed' 38 -> 57. robots.txt is byte-identical at 430 bytes and disallows only /register and /pages/, so the extra blocked URLs are almost certainly /pages/* discoveries - this needs confirming URL by URL.
Because the previous numbers came from a 4 Sep build, this is ten days of change landing at once, not a one-day collapse. Treat 14 Sep as the new baseline.
GSC traffic eased on a one-day window shift: clicks 47 -> 43, impressions 1,299 -> 1,192, average position 30.6 -> 31.1. CTR held at 3.6%.
14 Sep entered the window with 16 impressions and 0 clicks, the weakest day in the 28, which accounts for most of the impression fall.
Brand still carries search: 37 of 43 clicks (86.0%) are dxliving, dx living and dx_models. Every commercial non-brand query is still at zero clicks.

'3d rendering services melbourne' DROPPED OUT of the query table entirely, and four other Melbourne rendering queries lost impressions - the 12-article Melbourne rendering cluster is now visibly cannibalising itself.
'3d renders for builders melbourne' remains the closest non-brand query to page one at 13.1, recovering 0.2 after two consecutive slips.
GA4 sessions 614 -> 599 and events 3,082 -> 2,994 on the one-day window shift; users 368 -> 366 and key events flat at 7.
WEEKLY ENGAGEMENT FELL SHARPLY: 50.00% -> 29.46% week on week, average engagement time 1m 45s -> 8s, on almost the same volume (118 -> 112 sessions). Third consecutive fall.
Zero key events in BOTH 7-day windows for a twelfth scan. The homepage tag check passes (GTM, GA4 and Ads all firing), so this is a key-event configuration gap, not a collection failure.
Organic Social is 186 sessions at 24.73% engagement and THREE SECONDS average time. Social sends arrivals, not readers.
Organic Search is the only quality channel: 190 sessions at 65.26%, 1m 26s, and 5 of the 7 key events.

SPEED IMPROVED AGAIN: site mean TTFB 344 -> 315 ms, median 283 -> 265 ms, all 111 pages under one second for a fourth day - and for the first time no page above 600 ms. The /articles hub went 558 -> 414 ms; the homepage read slower at 322 -> 502 ms, which is live-measurement swing rather than a regression.
The /articles overlay is STILL THERE on day 21: a full-viewport fixed div at z-index 99999. Crawlers see all 88 articles; humans see a white screen.
NOTHING WAS PUBLISHED today - sitemap held at 112 URLs and 88 articles, word volume flat at 222,873. The first zero-publishing day in this series.
Ahrefs backlinks 378 -> 386 and referring domains 346 -> 353, but the FOLLOWED counts did not move at all (47 and 42). Every new link is nofollow.
AI visibility flat at 30/100 for an eleventh scan: 18 AI responses across 10 cited pages, ChatGPT 9, Copilot 8, Perplexity 1, Google AI Overviews still 0. Brand Radar prompts still 0.
Social: YouTube views 409 -> 531 as the new Short entered the window, Instagram reach 177 -> 211 and Facebook video 3-second views 282 -> 335. Follower base unchanged at 269 across all four channels.
